app.title: Watermark Slayer
app.subtitle: Local AI watermark detection and inpainting

modes.label: Mode
modes.single_tooltip: Process one image or video file.
modes.batch_tooltip: Process all supported files in a folder.

ghost.label: Transparent mode
ghost.tooltip: Make detected regions transparent instead of inpainting.

sigma_detect.label: Max detection area
sigma_detect.tooltip: Detections larger than this percentage of the image are skipped.

detection_prompt.label: Detection prompt
detection_prompt.tooltip: Tell the model what to detect, such as watermark, logo, or text.

output_format.label: Output format
output_format.tooltip: Auto keeps the original format when possible.

detection_skip.label: Detection interval
detection_skip.hint: Higher values are faster but may miss short-lived watermarks.

fade_in.label: Lead buffer
fade_in.hint: Extend the mask backward in time.

fade_out.label: Tail buffer
fade_out.hint: Extend the mask forward in time.

classes.title: Class Mapping
classes.empty: No classes are available. Check detection_classes.json.
classes.hint: Selected raw classes are merged into one output label for mask generation.

compare.title: Before / After
compare.subtitle: Detection preview and processed output stay side by side.
compare.after_empty: Detection boxes or processed output will appear here.

dropzone.title: Select a file or folder
dropzone.subtitle: Images, videos, and batch folders are supported

preview_modal.title: Detection Preview
preview_modal.loading_hint: The first run may need to download model files.

logs.first_run_hint: First run may download model files.
logs.ghost_video_warning: Transparent mode is not supported for videos. It has been disabled.
logs.no_ffmpeg: FFmpeg was not detected. Video output may not include audio.
logs.api_error: Backend API is unavailable. Start the app with run.sh or run.bat.
